title: Normalized native left comparison and representing counit lifts
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic, and a normalized realization family $R$ [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. For each separated finite-type model $T_0$, let $U_T$ be actual derived forgetting including closure transport, $C_T$ the common-stage constructible category and $\rho_T$ its realization. There are simultaneous ForgetModels $V_T:\mathcal W(T_0)\to C_T$ with $V_T\rho_T\simeq U_T$ such that the following holds. For every separated finite-type model morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$, every normalized coefficient system $S$ and compactification $c$ of its geometric base change, write $F\dashv G$ for the specified ordinary adjunction and $F^W$ for native compact support. There is a natural isomorphism $a:F^W V_Y\simeq V_XF$ such that, for each $L\in\mathcal W(Y_0)$, there are $H\in\mathcal W(X_0)$, $e:V_XH\simeq G(V_YL)$ and $d:F^WH\to L$ with $V_Yd=a_H;F(e);\epsilon_{V_YL}$. For every $K\in\mathcal W(X_0)$ the map $v\mapsto F^W(v);d$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(K,H)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F^WK,L)$. Semicolons denote composition in displayed order. No native right adjoint is assumed.

proof.text: The closureMap is a pullback of the algebraic-closure field equivalence, hence an isomorphism. Exact native forgetting preserves boundedness and its cohomology comparison carries constructible native cohomology to constructible ordinary cohomology. The direct image along closureMap is an exact equivalence and is naturally isomorphic to pullback along its inverse. Derive this isomorphism termwise and compare the total right-derived image with the exact termwise image. Pullback preserves bounded constructibility. Use the inverse-pullback complex as the witness in boundedConstructible, and apply sectionDerived.mapIso to the inverse comparison to identify its realization with U(K). This uses no general direct-image finiteness theorem. Family.data.image and full faithfulness now give a genuine functorial lift: Mathlib Functor.essImage.liftFunctor and liftFunctorCompIso define each ForgetModel on all morphisms. Choose these models simultaneously.

Choose normalized exact natural cyclic boundary families at X and Y using exists_cyclicDerivedHomBoundary. Apply the native normalized counit/Hom-square lemma to the chosen ForgetModels and these families. It gives a, and for every L gives H,e,d with the prescribed underlying counit equation, together with additive equivalences of the actual outer coinvariant and invariant groups and both commuting squares.

For fixed K use exactness to obtain the two rows with middle ambient native derived Hom groups. The additive middle map is u -> (nativeShriek.map (homMk u);d).hom. The left square is supplied by the new lemma; the right square follows after Subtype.ext from its forgetting square and the formulas for the two invariant quotient maps. Prove injectivity by the zero criterion: if the middle map kills m, the invariant equivalence and right square make q(m)=0; exactness writes m=i(v), and injectivity of the target boundary and coinvariant equivalence force v=0. For surjectivity lift the invariant image of a target m through the invariant equivalence and source q; the difference lies in the target boundary image, and correcting the lift by the inverse coinvariant image gives a preimage. Finally the full-subcategory hom inclusion is bijective, so lift the ambient result using homMk and hom_ext. This yields the stated native Hom bijection without discarding extension morphisms.

theorem native_exceptional_left_models (R : Family l D) :
    ∃ model : ∀ T : Space D, ForgetModel D l R T,
      ∀ (X Y : Space D) (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
        [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
        (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)),
      ∃ a : nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅
          (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F,
        ∀ L : W D l Y, ∃ (H : W D l X)
          (e : (model X).functor.obj H ≅
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj ((model Y).functor.obj L))
          (d : (nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H ⟶ L),
          (model Y).functor.map d = a.hom.app H ≫
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.map e.hom ≫
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).adjunction.counit.app ((model Y).functor.obj L) ∧
          ∀ K : W D l X,
            Function.Bijective (fun v : K ⟶ H ↦ (nativeShriek D l f₀).map v ≫ d)
